description: Looks up one US executive order by its EO number (for example 14148) and returns its title, signing and publication dates, Federal Register citation, president and official govinfo PDF. For anyone who sees an EO number in the news or a court filing and wants to know what it is, without guessing. Source: the Federal Register (FederalRegister.gov API), which covers orders published from 1994 onward; older orders are not found here. (cost: 1 credit)

eo_number.description: integer, required, executive order number, e.g. 14148

name: executive_order_by_number
